style_packs.title: Founder Explainer
style_packs.best_use: Founder-led lessons, startup decisions, operator reflections, and practical business explanations.
style_packs.poor_use: Highly comedic content, anonymous mystery stories, or posts that need fast meme timing.
style_packs.pacing: Measured hook, steady middle, reflective close.
style_packs.visuals: Founder workspace, notes, product sketches, support queues, abstract dashboards, no readable UI text.
style_packs.captions: Clear lesson-first copy with a practical takeaway.
style_packs.transitions: Simple cuts, push-ins, and match cuts between work artifacts.
style_packs.music: Warm minimal piano or soft pulse under narration.
style_packs.sfx: Sparse desk, keyboard, paper, or subtle notification textures.
style_packs.voice: Grounded founder reflection, credible and calm.
style_packs.avatar_policy: Avatar not needed by default; synthetic presenter allowed only if transparent and client-approved.
negative_rules: Do not invent traction, customer names, revenue, or proprietary details.
Do not show readable customer data or product UI.

style_packs.title: Cinematic Problem Solution
style_packs.best_use: Narratives that define a clear pain, reveal stakes, and resolve with a product, process, or insight.
style_packs.poor_use: Pure tutorials, jokes, or content where no meaningful transformation exists.
style_packs.pacing: Tension-forward opening, rising friction, clean solution turn, confident close.
style_packs.visuals: Problem state, friction details, contrast frames, and resolved outcome with consistent cinematic realism.
style_packs.captions: Problem then solution phrasing with one concrete promise that the source supports.
style_packs.transitions: Contrast cuts, match cuts, and reveal transitions.
style_packs.music: Subtle cinematic pulse that lifts at the solution turn.
style_packs.sfx: Low-impact transition hits and restrained environmental accents.
style_packs.voice: Confident, clear, and slightly dramatic without hype.
style_packs.avatar_policy: Usually no avatar; use presenter only when the solution needs an explicit human guide.
negative_rules: Do not manufacture urgency or guaranteed results.
Do not overstate the solution beyond evidence.

style_packs.title: Fast Reel Hook
style_packs.best_use: Short tactical tips, creator education, quick checks, and high-retention social advice.
style_packs.poor_use: Sensitive stories, reflective founder pieces, or complex topics needing nuance.
style_packs.pacing: Immediate hook, short beats, fast cuts, crisp close.
style_packs.visuals: Phone previews, editing timelines, abstract creator workflow, hands, and punchy motion.
style_packs.captions: Compact action-first captions with one direct instruction.
style_packs.transitions: Jump cuts, snap cuts, whip cuts, and hard cuts.
style_packs.music: Dry percussion, tight clicks, or fast clean pulse.
style_packs.sfx: Short taps, swipes, cuts, and edit hits used sparingly.
style_packs.avatar_policy: No avatar by default; creator hands or abstract UI are preferred.
negative_rules: Do not promise views, growth, or algorithm outcomes.
Do not overload scenes with explanation.

style_packs.title: Product Demo Walkthrough
style_packs.best_use: Product flows, feature walkthroughs, workflow explainers, and SaaS demos.
style_packs.poor_use: Emotional brand films, testimonials without product detail, or meme formats.
style_packs.pacing: Clear step-by-step progress with a short hook and benefit close.
style_packs.visuals: Abstract dashboards, blurred UI cards, workflow states, handoff moments, and product-adjacent motion.
style_packs.captions: Benefit and workflow clarity, not feature stuffing.
style_packs.transitions: Slides, morphs, and clean step transitions.
style_packs.music: Clean optimistic synth or light pulse.
style_packs.sfx: Soft clicks and state-change accents, never noisy.
style_packs.voice: Calm product walkthrough with plain language.
style_packs.avatar_policy: Presenter optional only if the demo needs a guide; avoid real likeness without consent.
negative_rules: Do not show readable proprietary UI or customer data.
Do not claim integrations or metrics not in the payload.

style_packs.title: Before After Transformation
style_packs.best_use: Workflow improvements, design upgrades, process changes, cleanup stories, and clear transformations.
style_packs.poor_use: Stories where the after state is speculative or unproven.
style_packs.pacing: Fast before state, clear turning point, satisfying after reveal.
style_packs.visuals: Split contrast implied through sequencing, not split panels; messy-to-clean progression.
style_packs.captions: Before, change, after in simple language.
style_packs.transitions: Match cuts, wipes, and reveal cuts that show contrast.
style_packs.music: Build from light tension to clean lift.
style_packs.sfx: Small whooshes or reveal hits, restrained.
style_packs.avatar_policy: No avatar by default; use process visuals first.
negative_rules: Do not fake before/after evidence.
Do not imply a guaranteed transformation.

style_packs.title: Client Testimonial Case Study
style_packs.best_use: Permissioned customer wins, anonymized case studies, and proof-backed service stories.
style_packs.poor_use: Unverified outcomes, private client details, or content without approval to share.
style_packs.pacing: Credibility-first hook, context, action, result, caveated lesson.
style_packs.visuals: Anonymized client context, abstract metrics, team workflow, and proof-safe visuals.
style_packs.captions: Outcome with context and no unsupported guarantee.
style_packs.transitions: Clean documentary cuts and evidence-focused reveals.
style_packs.sfx: Minimal; use only for evidence-card movement.
style_packs.voice: Credible case-study narrator, measured and specific.
style_packs.avatar_policy: Real client likeness requires consent; default to anonymized visuals or synthetic placeholders.
negative_rules: Do not reveal private client data.
Do not invent testimonial quotes or metrics.

style_packs.title: Educational Mini Lesson
style_packs.best_use: Short explainers, frameworks, tactical lessons, definitions, and myth corrections.
style_packs.poor_use: Heavy emotional stories, broad brand films, or content needing complex citations.
style_packs.pacing: Hook, simple frame, 2-4 teaching beats, summary close.
style_packs.visuals: Concrete examples, abstract diagrams without readable text, desk demonstrations, and simple visual metaphors.
style_packs.captions: Saveable lesson summary with one practical action.
style_packs.transitions: Clean chapter cuts and simple progression.
style_packs.music: Light neutral bed that stays behind teaching.
style_packs.sfx: Light emphasis taps or chapter hits.
style_packs.voice: Clear teacher voice, concise and friendly.
style_packs.avatar_policy: Presenter optional; no real likeness without consent.
negative_rules: Do not overcomplicate with jargon.
Do not present uncertain claims as settled facts.

style_packs.title: Meme Relatable Pain Point
style_packs.best_use: Lightweight pain-point relatability, B2B humor, creator frustrations, and social-native observations.
style_packs.poor_use: Sensitive topics, serious client proof, regulated claims, or trauma stories.
style_packs.pacing: Fast setup, recognizable pain, quick exaggeration, light resolution.
style_packs.visuals: Expressive situations, reaction shots, exaggerated workflow moments, no copyrighted meme templates.
style_packs.captions: Short relatable line, not a long explanation.
style_packs.transitions: Jump cuts, reaction cuts, and quick reversals.
style_packs.music: Playful minimal beat or comedic pulse.
style_packs.sfx: Small comedic hits, pauses, and notification textures.
style_packs.avatar_policy: Synthetic avatar allowed for generic character bits; avoid real-person parody without rights.
negative_rules: Do not punch down or mock customers.
Do not use copyrighted meme formats or celebrity likenesses.

style_packs.title: Premium Brand Film
style_packs.best_use: High-trust brand positioning, premium service/product launches, and cinematic identity pieces.
style_packs.poor_use: Quick tips, dense product walkthroughs, or low-stakes meme content.
style_packs.pacing: Slow hook, controlled build, elegant peak, sparse close.
style_packs.visuals: High-end lighting, considered composition, tactile details, restrained motion, premium environments.
style_packs.transitions: Elegant cuts, dissolves, and slow reveals.
style_packs.music: Refined cinematic bed, piano, strings, or ambient synth.
style_packs.sfx: Very sparse tactile sounds if they add premium feel.
style_packs.avatar_policy: Avoid avatar unless the brand has an approved presenter identity.
negative_rules: Do not use hype, clutter, or cheap urgency.
Do not make luxury claims without support.

style_packs.title: Local Business Promo
style_packs.best_use: Local shops, service businesses, restaurants, neighborhood events, and community offers.
style_packs.poor_use: National brand films, technical SaaS demos, or unverified local claims.
style_packs.pacing: Warm hook, craft or service detail, community moment, invitation close.
style_packs.visuals: Storefronts, hands at work, local environment, first customers, no readable addresses or private faces without consent.
style_packs.captions: Friendly local invitation with clear but non-pushy CTA.
style_packs.transitions: Soft cuts, match cuts, and warm detail transitions.
style_packs.music: Gentle acoustic, light soul, or warm local bed.
style_packs.sfx: Environmental textures like door chime, tools, kitchen, or street tone.
style_packs.avatar_policy: No avatar by default; real owner/staff likeness requires consent.
negative_rules: Do not mention real addresses, prices, staff names, or guarantees unless provided.
Do not show identifiable customers without consent.

style_packs.title: Avatar Sales Outreach
style_packs.best_use: Consent-aware synthetic presenter follow-ups, sales intros, and personalized outreach concepts.
style_packs.poor_use: Unconsented likeness use, sensitive topics, fake endorsements, or high-pressure claims.
style_packs.pacing: Transparent opening, relevance proof, value point, low-pressure next step.
style_packs.visuals: Synthetic presenter frame, abstract product context, prospect problem cards, calendar or handoff visuals.
style_packs.transitions: Clean presenter-to-context cuts and simple card transitions.
style_packs.sfx: Subtle UI or card movement only.
style_packs.voice: Professional, respectful, clear, and low pressure.
style_packs.avatar_policy: Synthetic or consent-approved avatar only; disclosure required; never imply unrecorded real-person endorsement.
negative_rules: Do not mimic a real person without consent.
Do not hide that presentation is synthetic.

style_packs.title: UGC Style Product Pitch
style_packs.best_use: Casual product pitches, creator-style demos, user-perspective benefits, and lightweight social proof.
style_packs.poor_use: Regulated claims, unverified testimonials, premium brand films, or serious crisis topics.
style_packs.pacing: Casual hook, personal problem, product moment, benefit, quick CTA.
style_packs.visuals: Handheld feel, desk or home environment, product-in-use shots, natural light, no fake platform UI.
style_packs.captions: Conversational first-person caption with clear disclosure when sponsored or synthetic.
style_packs.transitions: Handheld cuts, quick zooms, and natural action cuts.
style_packs.music: Light social-native beat that does not overpower voice.
style_packs.sfx: Natural product sounds and light taps.
style_packs.avatar_policy: Real UGC creator likeness requires consent and disclosure; synthetic presenter must be transparent.
negative_rules: Do not fake testimonials or user results.
Do not omit sponsorship or synthetic-presenter disclosure when required.
